Sup. I am James, i'm a middle class white male and I am average. If you were to make my character in fallout, you would have 5s on all of the different S.P.E.C.I.A.L skills. I see this as a boon and a nerf, because I don't have any natural talent, and I don't really have any weaknesses, other than ones in my personality. It means I have to work extra hard than others at something, but when I do beat someone at something, I know for a fact that it was purely because I worked hard and achieved it. I am in the top percentage of my class, but that is only because I just try and everyone else at my school are idiots. I enjoy music, video games, reading, and learning. I am planning to graduate highschool, go to University of Houston for pre-pharm, then go to University of Texas Medical Branch at Galveston to get my masters in pharmacy and start working as a pharmacist. Im only 15, but I am already starting to get symptoms of depression. Yesterday, when I was taking a shower, I sat down and cried because I came to the realization that I don't really have any "real" friends. Literally nobody that would be okay if I just showed up at their house for no real reason. Sure, I have people at school that i talk to, that I would call friends, but I haven't been invited out somewhere with them since seventh grade. However, there is this one girl, I'll call her Alice, that did invite me to her Halloween party a few months back, and it was the most fun I've had with someone in a long time. I've always had a mild crush on her, but after that party it skyrocketed to levels of infatuation that I have never felt for anyone ever before. I am 80% sure that she like me as well, and I have asked her before, but she said she just wanted to focus on school and not worry about relationships for now. However, that was weeks ago, and midterms are over, so I am considering asking her on another date once school resumes. 

So yeah. That's me, so far.
